Verified `DataFrame.join` API against the installed polars 1.42.1 signature.

```python
import polars as pl

names_df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Carol", "Dave"],
})

amounts_df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [2, 3, 5],
    "amount": [100, 250, 400],
})

result = names_df.join(amounts_df, on="id", how="inner")

print(result)
```
